# `company.statement_csv_mappings`

Named CSV column mappings saved per account for statement import.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this saved mapping row. |
| `account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_statement_csv_mappings_name | accounts.id | Account the mapping is saved for. |
| `name` | TEXT | no | — | — | ix_statement_csv_mappings_name | — | Name the mapping is saved and used under. |
| `mapping_snapshot` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | The CSV column mapping, as JSON. |
| `created_at` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp it was saved; the newest row for a name is used. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | — | Actor who saved it. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the save. |
